description: This file defines a Java interface 'ProductImageRemove' that extends another interface 'ImageRemove' and declares methods for removing product images in a sales management system.

classes.name: ProductImageRemove
classes.description: A Java interface for removing product images within the product management module, extending the generic ImageRemove interface.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a specific product image, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a given product, may throw a ServiceException.
